tei:div.tei:p: (kha)༄༅// sgra dbyangs lha mo dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ring brgyud bram ze phur bu'i lugs// ༄༅// swa ra swa tī/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang*// dri med zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus// rang nyid lha mo sku mdog dkar// phyag gnyis dri za'i pi wang sbreng*// zhabs gnyis tsog pur mnyam par bzhugs// stod smad dar dkar na bza' gsol// rin chen rgyan gyis sil khrol can// chags pa'i nyams dang ldan pa yi// snying ni pad+ma 'dab brgyad pa// lte bar ljang ser ze'u 'bru dmar// bsil zer can gyis mnan pa ni// 'jam zhing dkar la rgyas pa yi// dbus su hrīṃḥdang 'dab re la// dbyangs kyi yi ge gnyis gnyis gnas// dkar zhing 'tsher ba'i 'od zer 'phro// de yi 'od kyis 'jig rten gang*// lha mo'i thugs la reg gyur te// 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar byon// swa ra swa tī ar+ghaṃ sogs// mchod pas mchod cing bstod pas bstod// swa ra swa tī tiṣ+ṭha hrīṃḥ// ngag tu brjod pas 'khor lo de// 'od du gyur nas rang nyid kyi// sna nas zhugs nas snying la thim// rang dang lha mo dbyangs can ma// gnyis su med par gyur pa yis// shes bya kun la thogs med pa'i// blo gros rab tu rgyas par bsam// de nas hrīṃḥgi rtse mo las// hrīṃḥgi phreng ba kha nas thon// lte bar zhugs te 'khor ba yi// 'od kyis mun pa sel bar bsam// yang na dmigs pa 'di bzhin bya// yi ge thams cad mgo mjug bzlog /'dar zhing 'khrab las hrīṃḥ'aphros te// lte ba nas bud khar 'jug go /hrīṃḥgi phreng ba'i 'od zer gyis// 'phags dang mkhas pa nor bu'i rigs// rgyal po blon po bcas pa dang*// gzhon nu ma la sogs pa yi// mthu dang nus pa gzi brjid dang*// tshe dang bsod nams pradzñā sogs// rang dbang med par dbang bsdus te// rang gi snying la thim par bsam// de lta'i sems dang ma bral bas// 'bum phrag lnga yi bsnyen pa bya// de nas gnas khang gtsang ma ru// khrus byas gsar pa'i gos gyon te// dkar zhing 'jam pa'i stan la 'dug

/dmigs pa gong bzhin rtse gcig bsgom// skyo na hrīṃḥzhes mi tshig gis// bar ma chad du 'bum phrag lngas// dngos su'am brgyud pas 'grub par 'gyur// bu mos dkar gsum byin pa dang*/ shel phreng 'dogs dang me tog thu// ri la 'dzegs dang chu la brgal// nyi zla shar dang dkar dung 'bud// de sogs rmi lam byung gyur na// ring por mi thogs 'grub 'gyur cing*// blo gros 'phel bar the tshom med// de nas las la sbyar ba'i tshe// shags 'gyed rtsod pa gal che na// 'di bzhin byed kyis gzhan du sdig /rang lce 'khor lor bsgom pas chog /'gran zla de yi yar rkan la// lcags kyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa// mar rkan zangs kyi 'khor lo bsgom// lce la gser gyi rdo rje 'bar// rgya gram chen pos mnan par bsgom// de rnams lte bar yi ge hrīṃḥ// nag pos mi 'gyur bsdams par bsam// de yi khong par gser gyi ni// mchod rten chen po bang rim ldan// char khebs tog dang ldan pa yi// rtse mos gre phug khengs par bsam// rang gi lce la dbyangs can ma'i// 'khor lo shin tu gsal bar bsgom// ngag tu ming rus che ge mo'i// wāk stam+bha ya nan// zhes pa'i sngags 'di bzlas byas na// smra mkhas lce bde dran gsal ba// thams cad bdag gi dbang du 'gyur// mkhas pa rnams dang rgyal po dang*// de bzhin blon po bu mo sogs// bdag gi dbang du byed 'dod na// bsgrub bya mngon sum mthong ba la// de yi dpral bar pad+ma dmar// lte bar zla bar zur gsum pa// dmar la tsha ba'i reg byar ldan// de yi dbus su yi ge hrīṃḥ// zla tshes nā da ldan pa dgod// rang gi hrīṃḥlas hrīṃḥ'aphros te// dpral ba'i hrīṃḥdang dbyer med 'dres// 'od zer dmar po'i khongs su bcug /de yi lus sems dbang du bsdus// yi ge hrīṃḥgi rnam par gyur// tshur 'dus rang gi hrīṃḥl 'dres// ngag tu ming rus che ge mo// ā kar+ṣa ya dza bhaṣ+mi ku ru hoḥ

zhes pa'i gsang sngags bzlas gyur na// dge sbyong dag dang bram ze dang*// rgyal po la sogs lta ci smos// dbang po dpal mor bcas pa yang*// bran bzhin dbang du byed 'gyur zhing*// bsgo ba'i ngag la nyan par 'gyur// dug gis zin pa'i skyes bu yi// spyi bor pad+ma 'dab brgyad dkar// de steng zla ba cha gnyis rdzogs// dbus su dbyangs yig med pa yi// hrīṃḥdakar zla tshes nā da bral// thig le dngul chu lta bu bsgom// de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs te// spyi bo nas zhugs rtsa rnams gang*// dug rnams sgo nas bud par bsam// ngag tu ming rus che ge mo'i// bi ṣa shān+tiṅku ru swā hā// zhes pa'i gsang sngags bzlas gyur na// dug gis zin nas shi la thug /thams cad sos par the tshom med// gzhan yang byis pa btsas ma thag /rked pa nyi grib phyed mar bya// gi haṃ rgya skyegs 'dres pa yis// lce la dbyangs can 'khor lo dgod// dgug gzhug bcings pas dbyer med bya// hrīṃḥ.a ā i ī u ū ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄ e ai o au aṃ aḥ zhes pa'i sngags kyis brtan par bya// rig pa 'di yis byis pa rnams// dbyangs can nyid dang mtshungs par 'gyur// rang dang gzhan gyi don gyi phyir// sbyin sreg byas na lkugs pa yang*// snyan dngags mkhan tu 'gyur bar gsungs// de yi sgrub byed gzhan du bstan// rang nyid lha mor rab bsgom na// chags pa drag po skye mi 'gyur// snying ni 'khor lor bsgom gyur na// khams 'dus rna bas thos pa tsam// rang nyid lha mo nor rgyun mar// bsgom ste bā su dha ra'i gzungs// bzlas na nor rdzas 'phel bar 'gyur// dpal mo bsgom pa'ang man ngag yin// skabs su gsang sngags drag po'ang bgrang*// gtor ma dus la btang bar bya// srung 'khor 'dogs dang lug ru bsten// de sogs rnams la'ang 'gal ba med// bud med bral ba'i sa phyogs su// gtsang sbra gnas pa shin tu gces// thog mar skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang*// mjug tu bsngo ba yang byas na// bar chad ming yang mi 'byung ngo*// 'di ni ring du gsang bar bya// phyi nang gnyis kyi thun mong ba// blo gros spel ba'i man ngag 'di// zhag bdun tsam gyis 'grub 'gyur bas// gzhan las lhag pa'i khyad par yod// rang nyid nyams su mi len na// brgyud pa mang pos ci zhig bya// rang nyid nyams su len gyur na// brgyud pa med kyang lha mos skyong*// 'on kyang nyi ma rgyal mtshan dang*// rdo rje rgyal mtshan zhes par yang*// kho bo'i bla ma dag gis gsan// de las thos te yi ger bris// 'di ni lha mo de nyid kyis// rjes su bzung ba'i blo gros can// bi dza zhes pa'i ming can gyis// ma sbas gsal bar bkod pa'o// zhal nas zhal dang snyan nas snyan// thugs nas thugs su brgyud pa 'di// yi ger bkod pa bzod gsol zhing*// 'gro rnams blo gros 'phel gyur cig

/gzhan gyis ma tshor bar gsang nas nyams su len pa gal che'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
